headline: Body Connection, from entry to detail
overview: Practice body scan meditation for physical awareness. Guide your attention systematically through your body to release tension, build somatic awareness, and strengthen the mind-body connection.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Guided body scan meditation to build somatic awareness
Systematic attention through body regions to release tension
Track body connection practice sessions over time
Strengthen the mind-body connection through regular practice
tips: Lie down or sit in a comfortable position before starting — physical comfort helps you focus inward without distraction.
If your mind wanders during the scan, gently return attention to the body part you were focusing on without judgment.
